title: On touch the table scrolls sideways with the Subtotal pinned, chevrons toggle, and invoice links open in the same tab
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the report on a phone-sized viewport with data.
custom_steps:
1. Swipe the table sideways to reach the far columns.
2. Tap a customer chevron and an asset chevron.
3. Tap an invoice number link.
custom_expected:
1. The data table scrolls sideways to show all columns, and the pinned Subtotal column stays visible during that scroll.
2. The chevron expand and collapse control on each row works on touch.
3. The invoice number link opens the invoice in the same tab, the same as on desktop.
